# Best waterproof Bluetooth speakers for the pool or beach

**My top pick: JBL Charge 6**
- It's rated IP68, has 20 hours of battery (28 with Playtime Boost) and 40W of power, and sounds clear and detailed. It also works as a power bank. What Hi-Fi? named it best overall, and Best Products did too ([What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart), [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)).
- Prices listed: about $130 at Walmart, $150 at Amazon.
- Buy links are in the [What Hi-Fi? review list](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart).

**Other picks by need**

| Need | Speaker | Why | Price (as listed) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Loud pool party | JBL Boombox 4 | RTINGS' top waterproof pick. It floats, handles long immersion, and has 40+ hours of battery. Its sound is directional, so it's best aimed at listeners. | Check retailer links on [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth) |
| Even sound all around | Ultimate Ears Epicboom | IP67, floats, 360° sound, 15-hour battery. Tom's Guide's best overall and RTINGS' best mid-range. | See [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers) |
| Budget | Ultimate Ears Wonderboom 4 | IP67, floats, 360° sound, 14 hours. | About $65–80 ([Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)) |
| Cheapest / pocket-size | JBL Go 5 | IP67, 8 hours (10 with Playtime Boost), surprisingly good sound for its size. | About $40 ([What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart)) |
| Easy to carry to the beach | JBL Grip | IP68, under a pound, can-sized, 12 hours. Good Housekeeping's best overall. | About $100 ([Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/)) |

**Possible discount:** Dealectric lists a tested code, AFSC20, for the Soundcore Boom 3i rugged waterproof speaker. It takes the price from $129.99 to $104 ([buy link](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-3i)). The Boom 3i wasn't reviewed in the sources above, so I can't vouch for its sound. Dealectric earns a commission on purchases through its links.

**Care tips**
- IP ratings cover water getting in, not damage from salt or chlorine. RTINGS suggests at least rinsing the speaker with fresh water after use ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)).
- Keep the speaker on a towel instead of burying it in sand, and close the charging-port flap.
- Let it dry fully before charging ([iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers-for-the-beach-pool-and-shower/)).

I couldn't open retailer pages, so check the current price at checkout. If you tell me your budget and whether you want a pocket-size or party-size speaker, I can narrow it to one.
